impact: Broad relief after the worst S&P week since April 2025 lifts beaten-down holdings, but Tuesday's CPI and the Nvidia probe can quickly test it.
summary: US stocks rebounded hard Monday. The Dow rose 1,104.02 points (2.15%) to 52,389.75, the S&P 500 closed at 7,549.94 and the Nasdaq Composite at 25,253.14, up about 2.7%, leaving correction territory. Falling oil helped, while Nvidia lagged.
title: Dow jumps 1,104 points; Nasdaq up about 2.7% and exits correction
